design.title: Collapsible Timeline
design.summary: Add two-level collapse to the timeline section in dashboard.html: (1) section-level collapse via a button in the header, (2) day-level collapse via clickable date headers with chevrons.
design.approach: CSS class toggle with JavaScript — consistent with existing entry-level expand/collapse pattern
alternatives_rejected: Native <details>/<summary> — less styling control, inconsistent cross-browser chevron
CSS checkbox hack — fragile, poor accessibility, complex markup

change_points.details: Section collapse hides #tl and #filterBar. Day collapse hides .entry children. Chevron rotates 90deg when expanded.

change_points.action: Add Collapse/Expand button next to Clear History button
Wrap each day's entries in a <div class='date-group'> container. Add chevron and entry count to date headers. Add click handler on date headers.
change_points.details: Currently entries are flat siblings after date-head. New structure: date-group > (date-head + entries). Click handler: group.classList.toggle('day-collapsed')

change_points.action: Add toggleTimeline() and toggleAllDays() helper functions
change_points.details: toggleTimeline toggles .tl-collapsed on .timeline-wrap and updates button text. toggleAllDays batch-collapses/expands all day groups.

key_decisions.rationale: Matches existing .entry.expanded pattern used for individual entry collapse. Consistent UX and code style.
Currently entries are flat siblings of date-head. A wrapper div is needed to collapse a day's entries as a unit.

key_decisions.decision: No state persistence (collapse resets on re-render)
key_decisions.rationale: Simplest approach. Re-render happens on data refresh. Can add localStorage persistence later if needed.

key_decisions.decision: Show entry count badge on date headers
key_decisions.rationale: When a day is collapsed, the count badge (e.g. '(5)') gives quick context about how many entries are hidden.
Matches current behavior. No surprise UI changes for existing users.

edge_cases: Empty timeline → 'Nothing here' message, no collapse controls rendered
Filtered by project → collapse state works independently of filter, count reflects filtered entries
Re-render (new data arrives via polling) → collapse state resets (acceptable trade-off)
Single entry in a day → collapse still works, just one entry hidden

css_classes.date-group: Wrapper div for each day (header + entries)
css_classes.date-toggle: Chevron icon on date headers (▸), rotates when expanded
css_classes.day-collapsed: Applied to .date-group to hide child .entry elements
css_classes.date-count: Entry count badge on date headers
